state.authority: authenticated tenant/principal and current canonical conversation
state.retention: 24 hours with Mongo TTL removal; explicit delete and conversation retirement scrub original/extracted bytes before canonical lifecycle acknowledgement. Historical digest references remain in canonical messages and governance records; removed/expired refs cannot enter new context.
state.device_cache: references and filenames only; attachment bytes never enter workspace persistence

admission.rights: explicit authenticated acknowledgement of permission to use this file in this conversation; no training consent or cross-conversation reuse
admission.identity: server-issued UUID ref binds tenant, owner, conversation, effective classification (at least confidential and preserves restricted conversations), exact original sha256, filename, MIME, extractor identity, extracted content sha256 and immutable expiry
admission.retry: existing references resolve only the same stored immutable content and current rights; expiry/deletion never reconstructs content. A pending upload can recover after its fenced 60-second worker lease using the same upload ID and exact saved source, without repeating decoding.
admission.trust: canonical ContextSegment artifact with untrusted_evidence; uploaded content cannot become system instructions
admission.decoder_execution: At most two isolated decoders per backend process; 12-second response deadline and bounded terminate/kill cleanup. Complex PDF/media decoding requires OS resource limits (8 CPU seconds and 512 MiB address space). Decoder environment omits service credentials and audit guards reject network connections and external process execution.

deletion_scope: Deletion and expiry retire original attachment bytes and block new context admission. Already admitted engine context/execution checkpoints and derived replies retain their existing owner lifecycle; this interface does not claim historical erasure.

actual_capabilities.text: strict UTF-8 text/plain, markdown, CSV and JSON; no executable evaluation
actual_capabilities.pdf: bounded real text extraction only when pypdf is available, rejects encrypted/image-only documents and excessive pages/content; never fabricates OCR
actual_capabilities.images: verified PNG/JPEG/WebP actual pixels and geometry through existing decoder; context receives measured metadata, no vision/OCR claim
actual_capabilities.audio: verified integer PCM WAV actual samples and measured metadata through existing decoder; no ASR/transcription claim

failure_contract: foreign/missing conversation or attachment 404; invalid/unsupported files 422/415; expired/deleted refs 410; size/count bounds 413; unavailable extractor/storage/governance 503; failed upload never publishes an active ref
test_execution: deferred by explicit user steering; implementation and static source review only
